decisions.reason: The responsive template has not been observed on the website since 2018, which suggests its value is fading, but upkeep costs almost nothing, so the option stays open for now while it is close to being dropped.
Premium support fits the agency-focused, round-the-clock service model and brings recurring revenue at low marginal cost, so there is no reason to abandon it.
The version management tool builds on the firm's tooling that reduces recurring work for agencies, and keeping it costs little, so its strategic value justifies keeping it.

The GDPR contract tool is distant from the core offer and the early demand spike has probably passed, but a web tool is cheap to keep online and still supports compliance needs, so the option remains open with elevated withdrawal risk.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship that matches the firm's strategic direction, so the firm keeps committing to it rather than abandoning it.
